text:
kai: seeing a spike in token p95 for eu1 after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. p95 token latency went from 48ms -> 112ms for our default short-chat route.

mira: ugh, any correlation with KV cache hit rates?

kai: kv cache hit rate for the route dropped from 82% -> 61% around 2026-02-25 03:12 UTC. attaching profiling snippet:
```
route: short-chat
kernel_variant: v2-opt
p95_token_ms: 112
kv_hit: 0.61
kernel_select_ms: 3.4
kv_lookup_ms: 0.9
net_rtt_ms: 22
```

sam: deploy-bot shows a canary rollout at 03:10. @deploy-bot can you paste the rollout id?

deploy-bot: Rollout ID rlf_20260225_0310 applied to eu1 (canary 15%). Link: https://deploys/redwood/rlf_20260225_0310 :white_check_mark:

anya: this smells like kernel selection picked a variant with worse KV cache locality for short prefixes. We should compare kernel->quantization->kv affinity mapping.

mira: agree. Also we don't have token-level breakdown panels per-route in the regional dashboard. we only have overall p50/p95. we need: kernel_latency_ms, kvcache_lookup_ms, token_emit_ms, network_rtt_ms, and per-route request mix.

sam: can we add a derived metric "effective_token_latency_ms" = token_emit_ms + kernel_latency_ms + kvcache_lookup_ms? that'll help root cause.

kai: good idea. also need a failover-rate metric for routing decisions: count(route_routed_to_fallback) / count(route_requests) by region.

anya: I'll open a quick PR to add timers in the runtime and tag them with route_id, model_variant, region. keep it lightweight.

mira: add a sampling flag to full traces for now (1%) and export to s3://redwood-perf/profiles/1768623345-flame.tar.gz. upload once PR lands.

sam: for dashboards, panel suggestions:
- per-route token-level waterfall (stacked bars: kv, kernel, emit, net)
- per-region failover heatmap
- kernel-selection histogram by route (which variants picked)

kai: pinging @eng-infra to bump retention for these new metrics to 14d. @ops-bot can you file an infra ticket?

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created: "metric retention bump for token-level latency panels" assigned to eng-infra.

mira: timeline? if PR merges today we can have data within 1h, dashboards ready EOD.

anya: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1287 - adds timers + labels. please review.

sam: reviewed, left a small comment on metric cardinality limits. keep route_id cardinality bounded (use hashed prefix).

kai: action items: 1) anya adds timers + sampling PR (in flight) 2) eng-infra approves retention INF-4321 3) mira builds dashboard panels 4) sam reviews metric cardinality 5) monitor kv hit and p95 for 24h and rollback if regression persists.

mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
